```solidity
    // ============ Tests de Meta-transacciones (Gasless) ============

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
```
```solidity
    }
}

        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user2);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 5 ether}();
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar tiempo
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
        
        vm.prank(user1);
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalNotApproved.selector);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    function test_ExecuteProposal_DeadlineNotPassed() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalDeadlineNotPassed.selector);
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    function test_ExecuteProposal_SecurityPeriodNotPassed() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar tiempo solo hasta el deadline
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
        
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.SecurityPeriodNotPassed.selector);
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    function test_ExecuteProposal_AlreadyExecuted() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar tiempo y ejecutar
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
        
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
        
        // Intentar ejecutar de nuevo
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalAlreadyExecuted.selector);
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    // ============ Tests de Meta-transacciones (Gasless) ============

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

```solidity
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

    // ============ Tests de Meta-transacciones (Gasless) ============

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
```
```solidity
    }
}

        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user2);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 5 ether}();
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar tiempo
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
        
        vm.prank(user1);
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalNotApproved.selector);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    function test_ExecuteProposal_DeadlineNotPassed() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalDeadlineNotPassed.selector);
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    function test_ExecuteProposal_SecurityPeriodNotPassed() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar tiempo solo hasta el deadline
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
        
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.SecurityPeriodNotPassed.selector);
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    function test_ExecuteProposal_AlreadyExecuted() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar tiempo y ejecutar
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
        
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
        
        // Intentar ejecutar de nuevo
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalAlreadyExecuted.selector);
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    // ============ Tests de Meta-transacciones (Gasless) ============

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import {Test} from "forge-std/Test.sol";
import {DAOVoting} from "../src/DAOVoting.sol";
import {MinimalForwarder} from "../src/MinimalForwarder.sol";

contract DAOVotingTest is Test {
    MinimalForwarder public forwarder;
    DAOVoting public dao;
    
    address public user1 = address(0x1);
    address public user2 = address(0x2);
    address public user3 = address(0x3);
    address public beneficiary = address(0x4);
    address public relayer = address(0x5);
    
    uint256 private user1PrivateKey = 0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234;
    uint256 private user2PrivateKey = 0x2345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345;

    function setUp() public {
        forwarder = new MinimalForwarder();
        dao = new DAOVoting(address(forwarder));
        
        // Fundear cuentas
        vm.deal(user1, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(user2, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(user3, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(relayer, 100 ether);
    }

    // ============ Tests de Financiación ============

    function test_FundDAO() public {
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        assertEq(dao.getUserBalance(user1), 10 ether, "User1 balance should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(dao.totalBalance(), 10 ether, "Total balance should be 10 ether");
    }

    function test_FundDAO_Receive() public {
        vm.prank(user1);
        (bool success, ) = address(dao).call{value: 5 ether}("");
        assertTrue(success);
        
        assertEq(dao.getUserBalance(user1), 5 ether, "User1 balance should be 5 ether");
    }

    // ============ Tests de Creación de Propuestas ============

    function test_CreateProposal() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.id, 1, "Proposal ID should be 1");
        assertEq(proposal.recipient, beneficiary, "Recipient should match");
        assertEq(proposal.amount, 5 ether, "Amount should match");
        assertEq(proposal.deadline, deadline, "Deadline should match");
        assertFalse(proposal.executed, "Proposal should not be executed");
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_InsufficientThreshold() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 1 ether}(); // Solo 1 ETH, no suficiente para crear propuesta
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        vm.expectRevert();
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_InvalidRecipient() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();

        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.InvalidRecipient.selector, address(0)));
        dao.createProposal(address(0), 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();

        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.InvalidAmount.selector, uint256(0)));
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 0, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_DeadlineInPast() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp - 1; // Deadline en el pasado
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.DeadlineInPast.selector, deadline));
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    // ============ Tests de Votación ============

    function test_Vote_For() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(proposal.votesAgainst, 0, "Votes against should be 0");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    function test_Vote_Against() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);

        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 0, "Votes for should be 0");
        assertEq(proposal.votesAgainst, 10 ether, "Votes against should be 10 ether");
    }

    function test_Vote_Abstention() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();

        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.ABSTENCION);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesAbstention, 10 ether, "Votes abstention should be 10 ether");
    }

    function test_Vote_ChangeVote() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal1 = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal1.votesFor, 10 ether, "Initial votes for should be 10 ether");
        
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal2 = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal2.votesFor, 0, "Votes for should be 0 after change");
        assertEq(proposal2.votesAgainst, 10 ether, "Votes against should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA), "User vote should be EN_CONTRA");
    }

    function test_Vote_MultipleUsers() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user2);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 5 ether}();
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user3);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 3 ether}();
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 13 ether, "Total votes for should be 13 ether");
        assertEq(proposal.votesAgainst, 5 ether, "Total votes against should be 5 ether");
    }

    function test_Vote_InsufficientBalance() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user2);
        // Usuario sin balance
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.InsufficientBalance.selector, user2));
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_Vote_ProposalNotFound() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.ProposalNotFound.selector, uint256(999)));
        dao.vote(999, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_Vote_DeadlinePassed() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar el tiempo más allá del deadline
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
        
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.VotingDeadlinePassed.selector, uint256(1)));
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_Vote_AlreadyExecuted() public {

        // Avanzar tiempo y ejecutar

        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1); // Pasar período de seguridad
        
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
        
        // Intentar votar después de ejecución

        dao.fundDAO{value: 5 ether}();
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalAlreadyExecuted.selector);
```
```solidity
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
```
```solidity
    }
}

        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Avanzar tiempo y ejecutar
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days + 1);
        
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
        
        // Intentar ejecutar de nuevo
        vm.expectRevert(DAOVoting.ProposalAlreadyExecuted.selector);
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.executeProposal(1);
    }

    // ============ Tests de Meta-transacciones (Gasless) ============

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import {Test} from "forge-std/Test.sol";

contract DAOVotingTest is Test {

    address public user1 = address(0x1);

    uint256 private user2PrivateKey = 0x2345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345;

    function setUp() public {
        forwarder = new MinimalForwarder();
        dao = new DAOVoting(address(forwarder));

        vm.deal(user1, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(user2, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(user3, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(relayer, 100 ether);
    }

    // ============ Tests de Financiación ============

    function test_FundDAO() public {
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        assertEq(dao.getUserBalance(user1), 10 ether, "User1 balance should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(dao.totalBalance(), 10 ether, "Total balance should be 10 ether");
    }

    function test_FundDAO_Receive() public {
        vm.prank(user1);
        (bool success, ) = address(dao).call{value: 5 ether}("");

    }

    // ============ Tests de Creación de Propuestas ============

    function test_CreateProposal() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);

        vm.stopPrank();

        assertEq(proposal.id, 1, "Proposal ID should be 1");
        assertEq(proposal.recipient, beneficiary, "Recipient should match");
        assertEq(proposal.amount, 5 ether, "Amount should match");
        assertEq(proposal.deadline, deadline, "Deadline should match");
        assertFalse(proposal.executed, "Proposal should not be executed");
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_InsufficientThreshold() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 1 ether}(); // Solo 1 ETH, no suficiente para crear propuesta
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        vm.expectRevert();
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);

    }

        dao.createProposal(address(0), 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    }

        vm.stopPrank();

        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal2 = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal2.votesFor, 0, "Votes for should be 0 after change");
        assertEq(proposal2.votesAgainst, 10 ether, "Votes against should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA), "User vote should be EN_CONTRA");
    }

    function test_Vote_MultipleUsers() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);

        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    // ============ Tests de Meta-transacciones (Gasless) ============

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
```
```solidity
    }
}

        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

Ajustando los tests para usar la clave privada correcta. El problema es que `userPrivateKey` no corresponde al address `user`. Corrigiéndolo:


```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import {Test} from "forge-std/Test.sol";
import {MinimalForwarder} from "../src/MinimalForwarder.sol";
import {DAOVoting} from "../src/DAOVoting.sol";

contract MinimalForwarderTest is Test {
    MinimalForwarder public forwarder;
    DAOVoting public dao;
    
    address public relayer = address(0x2);
    
    // Clave privada conocida para testing (address: 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266)
    uint256 private userPrivateKey = 0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80;
    address public user;

    function setUp() public {
        forwarder = new MinimalForwarder();
        dao = new DAOVoting(address(forwarder));
        
        // Fundear el DAO con ETH
        vm.deal(user, 10 ether);
        vm.deal(relayer, 10 ether);
    }

    function test_GetNonce() public {
        uint256 nonce = forwarder.getNonce(user);
        assertEq(nonce, 0, "Nonce should be 0 initially");
    }

    function test_Verify_ValidRequest() public {
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);

        bool isValid = forwarder.verify(req, signature);
        assertTrue(isValid, "Request should be valid");
    }

    function test_Verify_InvalidNonce() public {
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 1, // Nonce incorrecto
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);

        bool isValid = forwarder.verify(req, signature);
        assertFalse(isValid, "Request should be invalid with wrong nonce");
    }

    function test_Execute_ValidRequest() public {
        vm.startPrank(user);
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 1 ether,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        vm.stopPrank();

        // El relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        (bool success, ) = forwarder.execute{value: 1 ether}(req, signature);
        
        assertTrue(success, "Execution should succeed");
        assertEq(forwarder.getNonce(user), 1, "Nonce should be incremented");
        assertEq(dao.getUserBalance(user), 1 ether, "User balance should be updated");
    }

    function test_Execute_ReplayAttack() public {
        vm.startPrank(user);
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 1 ether,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        vm.stopPrank();

        // Primera ejecución
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute{value: 1 ether}(req, signature);

        // Intento de replay attack
        vm.prank(relayer);
        vm.expectRevert("MinimalForwarder: signature does not match request");
        forwarder.execute{value: 1 ether}(req, signature);
    }

    function test_Execute_InvalidSignature() public {
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        // Firma inválida
        bytes memory signature = "invalid signature";

        vm.prank(relayer);
        vm.expectRevert("MinimalForwarder: signature does not match request");
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
                keccak256("MinimalForwarder"),
                keccak256("0.0.1"),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import {Test} from "forge-std/Test.sol";
import {DAOVoting} from "../src/DAOVoting.sol";
import {MinimalForwarder} from "../src/MinimalForwarder.sol";

contract DAOVotingTest is Test {
    MinimalForwarder public forwarder;
    DAOVoting public dao;
    
    address public user1 = address(0x1);
    address public user2 = address(0x2);
    address public user3 = address(0x3);
    address public beneficiary = address(0x4);
    address public relayer = address(0x5);
    
    uint256 private user1PrivateKey = 0x1234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234;
    uint256 private user2PrivateKey = 0x2345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345;

    function setUp() public {
        forwarder = new MinimalForwarder();
        dao = new DAOVoting(address(forwarder));
        
        // Fundear cuentas
        vm.deal(user1, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(user2, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(user3, 100 ether);
        vm.deal(relayer, 100 ether);
    }

    // ============ Tests de Financiación ============

    function test_FundDAO() public {
        vm.prank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        assertEq(dao.getUserBalance(user1), 10 ether, "User1 balance should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(dao.totalBalance(), 10 ether, "Total balance should be 10 ether");
    }

    function test_FundDAO_Receive() public {
        vm.prank(user1);
        (bool success, ) = address(dao).call{value: 5 ether}("");
        assertTrue(success);
        
        assertEq(dao.getUserBalance(user1), 5 ether, "User1 balance should be 5 ether");
    }

    // ============ Tests de Creación de Propuestas ============

    function test_CreateProposal() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.id, 1, "Proposal ID should be 1");
        assertEq(proposal.recipient, beneficiary, "Recipient should match");
        assertEq(proposal.amount, 5 ether, "Amount should match");
        assertEq(proposal.deadline, deadline, "Deadline should match");
        assertFalse(proposal.executed, "Proposal should not be executed");
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_InsufficientThreshold() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 1 ether}(); // Solo 1 ETH, no suficiente para crear propuesta
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        vm.expectRevert();
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_InvalidRecipient() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.InvalidRecipient.selector, address(0)));
        dao.createProposal(address(0), 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_InvalidAmount() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.InvalidAmount.selector, uint256(0)));
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 0, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    function test_CreateProposal_DeadlineInPast() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp - 1; // Deadline en el pasado
        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.DeadlineInPast.selector, deadline));
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
    }

    // ============ Tests de Votación ============

    function test_Vote_For() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(proposal.votesAgainst, 0, "Votes against should be 0");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    function test_Vote_Against() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.vote(1, DAOVoting.VoteType.EN_CONTRA);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 0, "Votes for should be 0");
        assertEq(proposal.votesAgainst, 10 ether, "Votes against should be 10 ether");
    }

    function test_Vote_Abstention() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();

    // ============ Tests de Meta-transacciones (Gasless) ============

    function test_Vote_Gasless() public {
        vm.startPrank(user1);
        dao.fundDAO{value: 10 ether}();
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        // Calcular domain separator exactamente como EIP712
        bytes32 domainTypeHash = keccak256(
            "EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"
        );
        
        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                domainTypeHash,
                keccak256(bytes("MinimalForwarder")),
                keccak256(bytes("0.0.1")),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        // Usar el mismo método que MessageHashUtils.toTypedDataHash
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

```solidity
        uint256 deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days;
        dao.createProposal(beneficiary, 5 ether, deadline);
        vm.stopPrank();
        
        // Preparar meta-transacción
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user1,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 100000,
            nonce: forwarder.getNonce(user1),
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.vote.selector, 1, DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR)
        });
        
        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(user1PrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        
        // Relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
        
        DAOVoting.Proposal memory proposal = dao.getProposal(1);
        assertEq(proposal.votesFor, 10 ether, "Votes for should be 10 ether");
        assertEq(uint256(dao.getUserVote(user1, 1)), uint256(DAOVoting.VoteType.A_FAVOR), "User vote should be A_FAVOR");
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        // Calcular domain separator exactamente como EIP712
        bytes32 domainTypeHash = keccak256(
            "EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"
        );
        
        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                domainTypeHash,
                keccak256(bytes("MinimalForwarder")),
                keccak256(bytes("0.0.1")),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        // Usar el mismo método que MessageHashUtils.toTypedDataHash
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

```solidity
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

    uint256 private user1PrivateKey = 0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80;
    uint256 private user2PrivateKey = 0x2345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345;

    function setUp() public {

        dao = new DAOVoting(address(forwarder));

        assertEq(dao.totalBalance(), 10 ether, "Total balance should be 10 ether");

        (bool success, ) = address(dao).call{value: 5 ether}("");

        assertEq(proposal.id, 1, "Proposal ID should be 1");

        assertFalse(proposal.executed, "Proposal should not be executed");
    }
```

```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.24;

import {Test} from "forge-std/Test.sol";
import {MinimalForwarder} from "../src/MinimalForwarder.sol";
import {DAOVoting} from "../src/DAOVoting.sol";

contract MinimalForwarderTest is Test {
    MinimalForwarder public forwarder;
    DAOVoting public dao;
    
    address public relayer = address(0x2);
    
    // Clave privada conocida para testing (address: 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266)
    uint256 private userPrivateKey = 0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80;
    address public user;

    function setUp() public {
        forwarder = new MinimalForwarder();
        dao = new DAOVoting(address(forwarder));
        
        // Obtener el address de la clave privada
        user = vm.addr(userPrivateKey);
        
        // Fundear el DAO con ETH
        vm.deal(user, 10 ether);
        vm.deal(relayer, 10 ether);
    }

    function test_GetNonce() public {
        uint256 nonce = forwarder.getNonce(user);
        assertEq(nonce, 0, "Nonce should be 0 initially");
    }

    function test_Verify_ValidRequest() public {
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);

        bool isValid = forwarder.verify(req, signature);
        assertTrue(isValid, "Request should be valid");
    }

    function test_Verify_InvalidNonce() public {
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 1, // Nonce incorrecto
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);

        bool isValid = forwarder.verify(req, signature);
        assertFalse(isValid, "Request should be invalid with wrong nonce");
    }

    function test_Execute_ValidRequest() public {
        vm.startPrank(user);
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 1 ether,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        vm.stopPrank();

        // El relayer ejecuta la transacción
        vm.prank(relayer);
        (bool success, ) = forwarder.execute{value: 1 ether}(req, signature);
        
        assertTrue(success, "Execution should succeed");
        assertEq(forwarder.getNonce(user), 1, "Nonce should be incremented");
        assertEq(dao.getUserBalance(user), 1 ether, "User balance should be updated");
    }

    function test_Execute_ReplayAttack() public {
        vm.startPrank(user);
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 1 ether,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        bytes32 digest = _hashTypedDataV4(req);
        (uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) = vm.sign(userPrivateKey, digest);
        bytes memory signature = abi.encodePacked(r, s, v);
        vm.stopPrank();

        // Primera ejecución
        vm.prank(relayer);
        forwarder.execute{value: 1 ether}(req, signature);

        // Intento de replay attack
        vm.prank(relayer);
        vm.expectRevert("MinimalForwarder: signature does not match request");
        forwarder.execute{value: 1 ether}(req, signature);
    }

    function test_Execute_InvalidSignature() public {
        MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req = MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest({
            from: user,
            to: address(dao),
            value: 0,
            gas: 50000,
            nonce: 0,
            data: abi.encodeWithSelector(DAOVoting.fundDAO.selector)
        });

        // Firma inválida (longitud incorrecta)
        bytes memory signature = "invalid";

        vm.prank(relayer);
        vm.expectRevert();
        forwarder.execute(req, signature);
    }

    // Helper function para hash de tipo EIP-712
    function _hashTypedDataV4(MinimalForwarder.ForwardRequest memory req) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        bytes32 typeHash = keccak256(
            "ForwardRequest(address from,address to,uint256 value,uint256 gas,uint256 nonce,bytes data)"
        );
        
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                typeHash,
                req.from,
                req.to,
                req.value,
                req.gas,
                req.nonce,
                keccak256(req.data)
            )
        );

        // Calcular domain separator exactamente como EIP712
        bytes32 domainTypeHash = keccak256(
            "EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"
        );
        
        bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                domainTypeHash,
                keccak256(bytes("MinimalForwarder")),
                keccak256(bytes("0.0.1")),
                block.chainid,
                address(forwarder)
            )
        );

        // Usar el mismo método que MessageHashUtils.toTypedDataHash
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash));
    }
}
```

# Cómo funciona el sistema DAO con meta-transacciones

## Arquitectura general

El sistema tiene dos contratos principales:
1. MinimalForwarder: maneja meta-transacciones (EIP-2771)
2. DAOVoting: contrato DAO con sistema de votación

---

## 1. MinimalForwarder — el relayer de meta-transacciones

### ¿Qué hace?
Permite que los usuarios firmen transacciones fuera de la blockchain y que un tercero (relayer) las ejecute pagando el gas.

### Componentes principales

```solidity
struct ForwardRequest {
    address from;      // Usuario que quiere ejecutar la acción
    address to;        // Contrato destino (DAOVoting)
    uint256 value;     // ETH a enviar (si es necesario)
    uint256 gas;       // Gas a usar
    uint256 nonce;     // Número único para prevenir replay attacks
    bytes data;        // Datos de la función a ejecutar
}
```

### Flujo de una meta-transacción

```
┌─────────────┐
│   Usuario   │
│  (Off-chain)│
└──────┬──────┘
       │
       │ 1. Firma ForwardRequest con su clave privada
       │    (EIP-712: firma tipada estructurada)
       │
       ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│  Firma Off-chain │
│  (bytes signature)│
└──────┬───────────┘
       │
       │ 2. Envía firma al Relayer (API/Backend)
       │
       ▼
┌─────────────┐
│  Relayer    │
│  (Backend)  │
└──────┬──────┘
       │
       │ 3. Llama a MinimalForwarder.execute()
       │    Pagando el gas
       │
       ▼
┌──────────────────┐
│ MinimalForwarder │
└──────┬───────────┘
       │
       │ 4. Verifica la firma
       │ 5. Valida el nonce
       │ 6. Ejecuta la llamada al DAO
       │    (agregando la dirección del usuario al final de data)
       │
       ▼
┌─────────────┐
│  DAOVoting  │
└─────────────┘
```

### Funciones clave

#### `getNonce(address from)`
- Retorna el nonce actual del usuario
- Previene replay attacks: cada transacción debe tener un nonce único

#### `verify(ForwardRequest, signature)`
- Verifica la firma EIP-712
- Valida que el nonce sea correcto
- Confirma que el firmante coincide con `from`

#### `execute(ForwardRequest, signature)`
1. Verifica la firma con `verify()`
2. Incrementa el nonce del usuario
3. Ejecuta la llamada al contrato destino
4. Agrega la dirección del usuario al final de `data` (requisito EIP-2771)

### Ejemplo práctico

```solidity
// Usuario quiere votar sin pagar gas
ForwardRequest memory req = ForwardRequest({
    from: usuario,
    to: daoAddress,
    value: 0,
    gas: 100000,
    nonce: forwarder.getNonce(usuario), // 0, 1, 2, ...
    data: abi.encodeWithSelector(
        DAOVoting.vote.selector, 
        proposalId, 
        VoteType.A_FAVOR
    )
});

// Usuario firma off-chain (EIP-712)
bytes memory signature = signTypedData(req);

// Relayer ejecuta (paga gas)
forwarder.execute(req, signature);
```

---

## 2. DAOVoting — el contrato DAO

### ¿Qué hace?
Gestiona propuestas, votación y ejecución de decisiones. Hereda de `ERC2771Context` para recibir llamadas del MinimalForwarder y extraer el usuario real.

### Componentes principales

#### Estructura de una propuesta

```solidity
struct Proposal {
    uint256 id;                    // ID único (1, 2, 3...)
    address recipient;              // Beneficiario que recibirá los fondos
    uint256 amount;                // Cantidad de ETH a transferir
    uint256 deadline;               // Fecha límite de votación
    uint256 votesFor;              // Peso total de votos a favor
    uint256 votesAgainst;          // Peso total de votos en contra
    uint256 votesAbstention;       // Peso total de abstenciones
    bool executed;                 // Si ya fue ejecutada
    uint256 executionTime;         // Cuándo se ejecutó
    uint256 creationTime;          // Cuándo se creó
}
```

#### Sistema de votación

Los votos tienen peso según el balance del usuario en el DAO:
- Si un usuario tiene 10 ETH en el DAO, su voto vale 10
- Si otro tiene 5 ETH, su voto vale 5

### Flujo completo del DAO

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   1. FINANCIACIÓN                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Usuario → fundDAO() → Deposita ETH
         ↓
    userBalances[usuario] += amount
    totalBalance += amount
```

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                2. CREACIÓN DE PROPUESTA                 │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Usuario (con ≥10% del balance) → createProposal()
         ↓
    Validaciones:
    - Usuario tiene ≥10% del balance total
    - Recipient válido (no address(0))
    - Amount > 0
    - Deadline en el futuro
         ↓
    proposalCount++
    proposals[proposalId] = nueva propuesta
```

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                      3. VOTACIÓN                        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Usuario → vote(proposalId, voteType)
         ↓
    Validaciones:
    - Propuesta existe
    - No ha sido ejecutada
    - Deadline no ha pasado
    - Usuario tiene balance > 0
         ↓
    Si usuario ya votó:
    - Resta su voto anterior
         ↓
    Agrega nuevo voto:
    - votesFor += userBalance (si A_FAVOR)
    - votesAgainst += userBalance (si EN_CONTRA)
    - votesAbstention += userBalance (si ABSTENCION)
```

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   4. EJECUCIÓN                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Cualquiera → executeProposal(proposalId)
         ↓
    Validaciones:
    - Propuesta existe
    - No ha sido ejecutada
    - Deadline ha pasado
    - votesFor > votesAgainst (aprobada)
    - Ha pasado SECURITY_PERIOD (1 día) desde deadline
         ↓
    Transferencia:
    - recipient.call{value: amount}()
    - proposal.executed = true
```

### Función: `_msgSender()` de ERC2771Context

Esta función es crucial. Cuando el DAO recibe una llamada:

```solidity
// Si la llamada viene del MinimalForwarder (trusted forwarder)
if (isTrustedForwarder(msg.sender)) {
    // Extrae la dirección real del usuario del final de msg.data
    return address(bytes20(msg.data[msg.data.length - 20:]));
} else {
    // Llamada normal, retorna msg.sender
    return msg.sender;
}
```

Esto permite que el DAO identifique al usuario real aunque la llamada venga del MinimalForwarder.

---

## 3. Flujo completo: votación gasless

Ejemplo de un usuario votando sin pagar gas:

### Paso 1: Usuario prepara la transacción

```javascript
// Frontend (JavaScript)
const nonce = await forwarder.getNonce(userAddress);

const request = {
    from: userAddress,
    to: daoAddress,
    value: 0,
    gas: 100000,
    nonce: nonce,
    data: ethers.utils.defaultAbiCoder.encode(
        ["bytes4", "uint256", "uint8"],
        [
            dao.interface.getSighash("vote"),
            proposalId,
            VoteType.A_FAVOR
        ]
    )
};

// Firma EIP-712
const signature = await signer._signTypedData(
    domain,
    types,
    request
);
```

### Paso 2: Usuario envía la firma al relayer

```javascript
// Frontend envía al backend
fetch('/api/relay', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ request, signature })
});
```

### Paso 3: Relayer ejecuta la transacción

```javascript
// Backend (API Route)
const tx = await forwarder.execute(request, signature, {
    value: request.value,
    gasLimit: request.gas
});
```

### Paso 4: MinimalForwarder procesa

```solidity
// MinimalForwarder.execute()
1. Verifica firma ✓
2. Valida nonce ✓
3. Incrementa nonce: _nonces[from]++
4. Ejecuta: dao.call{data: request.data + from}
```

### Paso 5: DAOVoting recibe la llamada

```solidity
// DAOVoting.vote()
1. _msgSender() extrae la dirección real del usuario
2. Valida que el usuario tiene balance
3. Registra el voto con el peso correcto
4. Emite evento VoteCast
```

---

## 4. Seguridad

### Prevención de replay attacks
- Nonces: cada transacción usa un nonce único e incremental
- Una transacción firmada solo se puede ejecutar una vez

### Trusted forwarder
- El DAO solo acepta llamadas del MinimalForwarder registrado
- Un forwarder malicioso no puede falsificar usuarios

### Período de seguridad
- Después del deadline, hay 1 día adicional antes de poder ejecutar
- Permite tiempo para revisar antes de la ejecución

### Validaciones de votación
- Un usuario no puede votar sin balance
- No se puede votar después del deadline
- No se puede votar en propuestas ya ejecutadas
- El peso del voto es proporcional al balance del usuario

---

## 5. Ejemplo de uso completo

Escenario: Usuario A quiere votar en una propuesta sin pagar gas

```
1. Usuario A deposita 10 ETH en el DAO
   → userBalances[A] = 10 ETH
   → totalBalance = 10 ETH

2. Usuario B (con ≥10% del balance) crea propuesta
   → proposalId = 1
   → deadline = block.timestamp + 7 days

3. Usuario A quiere votar A FAVOR (sin pagar gas):
   
   a) Obtiene nonce: forwarder.getNonce(A) = 0
   
   b) Crea request con:
      - from: A
      - to: DAO address
      - data: vote(1, A_FAVOR)
      - nonce: 0
   
   c) Firma con EIP-712 (off-chain)
   
   d) Envía firma al relayer
   
   e) Relayer llama: forwarder.execute(request, signature)
      → Paga el gas
      → MinimalForwarder verifica y ejecuta
   
   f) DAO recibe llamada:
      → _msgSender() = A (usuario real)
      → votesFor += 10 ETH (peso del voto de A)
      → proposal.votesFor = 10 ETH

4. Después del deadline + security period:
   → Usuario C llama executeProposal(1)
   → DAO transfiere 5 ETH al beneficiario
   → proposal.executed = true
```

---

## Resumen

- MinimalForwarder: permite que los usuarios firmen transacciones off-chain y que un relayer las ejecute pagando el gas.
- DAOVoting: gestiona propuestas, votación con peso proporcional al balance y ejecución segura.
- ERC2771Context: permite que el DAO identifique al usuario real aunque la llamada venga del forwarder.
- Seguridad: nonces, trusted forwarder, período de seguridad y validaciones.

**Cursor**

Aclarando la diferencia entre el tipo de voto y el peso del voto con ejemplos del código:


Son dos conceptos distintos:

1. Tipo de voto: A FAVOR, EN CONTRA, ABSTENCIÓN
2. Peso del voto: cuánto vale ese voto (según el balance del usuario)

Mirando el código:

```206:212:sc/src/DAOVoting.sol
        // Agregar el nuevo voto
        if (voteType == VoteType.A_FAVOR) {
            proposal.votesFor += userBalances[sender];
        } else if (voteType == VoteType.EN_CONTRA) {
            proposal.votesAgainst += userBalances[sender];
        } else if (voteType == VoteType.ABSTENCION) {
            proposal.votesAbstention += userBalances[sender];
        }
```

Ejemplo:

Supongamos tres usuarios:
- Usuario A: 10 ETH en el DAO
- Usuario B: 5 ETH en el DAO
- Usuario C: 3 ETH en el DAO

Votación en una propuesta:

```
Usuario A vota: A_FAVOR
  → votesFor += 10 ETH  (porque userBalances[A] = 10 ETH)

Usuario B vota: EN_CONTRA
  → votesAgainst += 5 ETH  (porque userBalances[B] = 5 ETH)

Usuario C vota: A_FAVOR
  → votesFor += 3 ETH  (porque userBalances[C] = 3 ETH)
```

Resultado final:
- `votesFor = 10 + 3 = 13 ETH`
- `votesAgainst = 5 ETH`
- `votesAbstention = 0 ETH`

¿Por qué se usa el balance como peso?

Es un sistema de votación ponderado: más participación en el DAO = más peso. No es “1 voto = 1 persona”.

Ejemplo:

```
Escenario 1: Votación simple (1 voto = 1 persona)
- Usuario A: 100 ETH → 1 voto
- Usuario B: 1 ETH → 1 voto
- Usuario C: 1 ETH → 1 voto
Resultado: 2 votos a favor, 1 en contra (A y C vs B)

Escenario 2: Votación ponderada (según balance)
- Usuario A: 100 ETH → vota A_FAVOR → peso = 100
- Usuario B: 1 ETH → vota EN_CONTRA → peso = 1
- Usuario C: 1 ETH → vota A_FAVOR → peso = 1
Resultado: 101 votos a favor, 1 en contra (A gana por mucho)
```

¿Quieres que lo cambie a “1 voto = 1 persona”?

Si prefieres que cada usuario tenga el mismo peso independientemente de su balance, puedo modificarlo. ¿Lo cambio?

```plaintext
        } else if (voteType == VoteType.EN_CONTRA) {
            proposal.votesAgainst += userBalances[sender];
        } else if (voteType == VoteType.ABSTENCION) {
            proposal.votesAbstention += userBalances[sender];
        }
```

```plaintext
Usuario C vota: A_FAVOR

```
